purpose: What the correction to the screening pools (python ml/pipeline.py screenhull, ml/screen_hull.update_progress) may change in progress/progress.json. Written before the run on main. The step adds one field to the screen block, /hull, with each published candidate's distance to the convex hull computed from JARVIS-DFT's own formation energies, and one entry to the activity log. It changes no list, rank, score or text of the published screen: taking the field out again must give the screen block as it was, and the checks of the round-5 audit and of screening round 6 then run on it unchanged.
also_rewritten: /updated, which the record of the release run already carries with its audited value
not_rewritten: The published statements that the pools lie within 50 meV/atom of the convex hull (screen.pool.rule, screen.hurricane.pool.rule, the steps in results/screen_round*.json and results/hurricane_round*.json) stay as they were written; the field and the record are the correction, and the app shows it next to them.
